## Coordinate transformations

The final activities connect parameter descriptions to geometry. In each one,
a small set of algebraic parameters determines a visible object or region.
Matching a target therefore requires reasoning in both representations: which
parameter is wrong, and what geometric change will correcting it produce?

### Transform a cuboid in 3D

An affine transformation combines a linear change of shape and orientation
with a translation. In this activity the map has the form
$T(p)=sR_z(\theta)p+t$: the cuboid is scaled uniformly by $s$, rotated about
the $z$-axis by $\theta$, and translated by $t=(t_x,t_y,t_z)$. Matching the
wireframes builds a geometric understanding of how those parameters affect a
3D object and how the operations compose.

Match the orange cuboid to the fixed green target. Move the five sliders for
translation, uniform scale, and rotation about the $z$-axis. The unequal side
lengths make the orientation visible. You may drag the 3D view to inspect the
result; only the sliders are assessed.

```{.jsxgraph assessment_id="cube-transform-board" width="900" height="650" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; max-width:100%;"}
var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, {
  boundingbox: [-8, 8, 8, -8],
  axis: false,
  pan: { enabled: false },
  zoom: { enabled: false },
  showNavigation: false
});
var view = board.create('view3d', [[-7.3, -2.2], [14.6, 9.5],
  [[-4, 4], [-4, 4], [-3, 4]]], {
  xPlaneRear: { visible: false },
  yPlaneRear: { visible: false },
  zPlaneRear: { fillOpacity: 0.08 }
});

var tx = board.create('slider', [[-7, -3.4], [-1.5, -3.4], [-2, -0.5, 2]], {
  name: 'x', snapWidth: 0.25, precision: 2
});
var ty = board.create('slider', [[1, -3.4], [6.5, -3.4], [-2, 0.75, 2]], {
  name: 'y', snapWidth: 0.25, precision: 2
});
var tz = board.create('slider', [[-7, -4.7], [-1.5, -4.7], [-1, 0, 2]], {
  name: 'z', snapWidth: 0.25, precision: 2
});
var scale = board.create('slider', [[1, -4.7], [6.5, -4.7], [0.5, 0.75, 1.75]], {
  name: 'scale', snapWidth: 0.05, precision: 2
});
var angle = board.create('slider', [[-4.5, -6.0], [4.5, -6.0], [-90, -30, 90]], {
  name: 'angle (degrees)', snapWidth: 5, precision: 0
});

var base = [
  [-1, -0.65, -0.45], [1, -0.65, -0.45], [1, 0.65, -0.45], [-1, 0.65, -0.45],
  [-1, -0.65, 0.45], [1, -0.65, 0.45], [1, 0.65, 0.45], [-1, 0.65, 0.45]
];
var edges = [[0,1],[1,2],[2,3],[3,0],[4,5],[5,6],[6,7],[7,4],[0,4],[1,5],[2,6],[3,7]];
var target = { tx: 1, ty: -1, tz: 1, scale: 1.25, angle: 45 };

function transformed(vertex, values) {
  var radians = values.angle * Math.PI / 180;
  var x = values.scale * vertex[0];
  var y = values.scale * vertex[1];
  return [
    values.tx + x * Math.cos(radians) - y * Math.sin(radians),
    values.ty + x * Math.sin(radians) + y * Math.cos(radians),
    values.tz + values.scale * vertex[2]
  ];
}
function current() {
  return { tx: tx.Value(), ty: ty.Value(), tz: tz.Value(),
    scale: scale.Value(), angle: angle.Value() };
}
function addWireframe(values, color, dynamic) {
  edges.forEach(function (edge) {
    view.create('curve3d', [
      function (t) {
        var v = dynamic ? current() : values;
        var a = transformed(base[edge[0]], v);
        var b = transformed(base[edge[1]], v);
        return a[0] + t * (b[0] - a[0]);
      },
      function (t) {
        var v = dynamic ? current() : values;
        var a = transformed(base[edge[0]], v);
        var b = transformed(base[edge[1]], v);
        return a[1] + t * (b[1] - a[1]);
      },
      function (t) {
        var v = dynamic ? current() : values;
        var a = transformed(base[edge[0]], v);
        var b = transformed(base[edge[1]], v);
        return a[2] + t * (b[2] - a[2]);
      }, [0, 1]
    ], { strokeColor: color, strokeWidth: dynamic ? 4 : 5, fixed: true, highlight: false });
  });
}
addWireframe(target, '#15803d', false);
addWireframe(null, '#f97316', true);
board.create('text', [-7, 7.2, '<b>Green:</b> target &nbsp; <b style="color:#c2410c">Orange:</b> your cuboid'], {
  fixed: true, fontSize: 16
});

JXG.QuartoAssessment.register({
  board: board,
  response: function () {
    var v = current();
    return { representation: 'cuboid-transform', translation: [v.tx, v.ty, v.tz],
      scale: v.scale, zRotationDegrees: v.angle };
  },
  ai: { render: true, summary: function (data) {
    return { representation: data.representation, translation: data.translation,
      scale: data.scale, zRotationDegrees: data.zRotationDegrees,
      feedbackPolicy: 'Explain which transformation parameter to adjust without revealing target values.' };
  }}
});
```

```{math-exercise}
#|               "feedback": "Still adjust: " + ", ".join(remaining) + "."}

Use the sliders to make the orange cuboid coincide with the green cuboid.
```

### Match a polar-coordinate region

Polar coordinates describe a point by its distance $r$ from the origin and its
angle $\varphi$. A rectangle
$[r_{\min},r_{\max}]\times[\varphi_{\min},\varphi_{\max}]$ in parameter space
becomes an annular sector under
$(r,\varphi)\mapsto(r\cos\varphi,r\sin\varphi)$. Matching the boundary makes
the connection between algebraic bounds and the resulting planar region
visible.

The blue target is an annular sector. Move the four sliders to match it with
the orange outline. Radii are ordinary coordinates; the two angle sliders are
multiples of $\pi$ (for example, `0.5` means $\pi/2$). Only the slider values
are assessed.

```{.jsxgraph assessment_id="polar-sector-board" width="900" height="570" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; max-width:100%;"}
var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, {
  boundingbox: [-5.2, 5.2, 5.2, -6.2], axis: true,
  pan: { enabled: false }, zoom: { enabled: false }, showNavigation: false
});
var rMin = board.create('slider', [[-4.7,-4.2],[-0.5,-4.2],[0,0.75,3.5]], { name:'r min', snapWidth:0.25, precision:2 });
var rMax = board.create('slider', [[0.6,-4.2],[4.8,-4.2],[0.5,2.25,4]], { name:'r max', snapWidth:0.25, precision:2 });
var aMin = board.create('slider', [[-4.7,-5.25],[-0.5,-5.25],[0,0.1,1.75]], { name:'angle min / pi', snapWidth:0.05, precision:2 });
var aMax = board.create('slider', [[0.6,-5.25],[4.8,-5.25],[0.25,0.65,2]], { name:'angle max / pi', snapWidth:0.05, precision:2 });
var target = { r0: 1.5, r1: 3, a0: 0.25, a1: 0.75 };

function addSector(getBounds, color, width) {
  function angle(t) { var b=getBounds(); return Math.PI*(b.a0+t*(b.a1-b.a0)); }
  function radius(t) { var b=getBounds(); return b.r0+t*(b.r1-b.r0); }
  [0,1].forEach(function (outer) {
    board.create('curve', [
      function (t) { var b=getBounds(); var r=outer ? b.r1 : b.r0; return r*Math.cos(angle(t)); },
      function (t) { var b=getBounds(); var r=outer ? b.r1 : b.r0; return r*Math.sin(angle(t)); },
      0, 1
    ], { strokeColor:color, strokeWidth:width, fixed:true, highlight:false });
  });
  [0,1].forEach(function (upper) {
    board.create('curve', [
      function (t) { var b=getBounds(); return radius(t)*Math.cos(Math.PI*(upper ? b.a1 : b.a0)); },
      function (t) { var b=getBounds(); return radius(t)*Math.sin(Math.PI*(upper ? b.a1 : b.a0)); },
      0, 1
    ], { strokeColor:color, strokeWidth:width, fixed:true, highlight:false });
  });
}
addSector(function () { return target; }, '#2563eb', 7);
addSector(function () { return { r0:rMin.Value(), r1:rMax.Value(), a0:aMin.Value(), a1:aMax.Value() }; }, '#f97316', 4);
board.create('text', [-4.8,4.65,'<b style="color:#1d4ed8">Blue:</b> target &nbsp; <b style="color:#c2410c">Orange:</b> your region'], { fixed:true, fontSize:16 });

JXG.QuartoAssessment.register({
  board: board,
  response: function () { return { representation:'polar-sector-bounds',
    radius:[rMin.Value(),rMax.Value()], anglePi:[aMin.Value(),aMax.Value()] }; },
  ai: { render:true, summary:function (data) { return {
    representation:data.representation, radius:data.radius, anglePi:data.anglePi,
    feedbackPolicy:'Discuss radial and angular bounds separately without revealing target values.'
  }; }}
});
```

```{math-exercise}

Use the sliders so that the orange outline coincides with the blue polar region.
```

### Match a cylindrical-coordinate region

Cylindrical coordinates add height $z$ to polar coordinates. A parameter box
$[r_{\min},r_{\max}]\times[\varphi_{\min},\varphi_{\max}]
\times[z_{\min},z_{\max}]$ becomes a curved 3D sector under
$(r,\varphi,z)\mapsto(r\cos\varphi,r\sin\varphi,z)$. Adjusting the six bounds
helps distinguish the radial, angular, and vertical faces of this transformed
region.

The green wireframe shows a target region under the cylindrical-coordinate
map $(r,\varphi,z)\mapsto(r\cos\varphi,r\sin\varphi,z)$. Match it with the
orange wireframe using six sliders. Angle values are multiples of $\pi$. Drag
the 3D view to inspect hidden edges; only the sliders are assessed.

```{.jsxgraph assessment_id="cylindrical-sector-board" width="900" height="760" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; max-width:100%;"}
var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, {
  boundingbox: [-8, 9, 8, -12], axis:false,
  pan:{enabled:false}, zoom:{enabled:false}, showNavigation:false
});
var view = board.create('view3d', [[-7.2,-1.5],[14.4,9.5], [[-4,4],[-4,4],[-3,4]]], {
  xPlaneRear:{visible:false}, yPlaneRear:{visible:false}
});
var r0 = board.create('slider',[[-7,-3.1],[-1.2,-3.1],[0,0.5,3]],{name:'r min',snapWidth:0.25,precision:2});
var r1 = board.create('slider',[[1,-3.1],[6.8,-3.1],[0.5,2,3.5]],{name:'r max',snapWidth:0.25,precision:2});
var a0 = board.create('slider',[[-7,-4.6],[-1.2,-4.6],[0,0.1,1.5]],{name:'angle min / pi',snapWidth:0.05,precision:2});
var a1 = board.create('slider',[[1,-4.6],[6.8,-4.6],[0.25,0.6,2]],{name:'angle max / pi',snapWidth:0.05,precision:2});
var z0 = board.create('slider',[[-7,-6.1],[-1.2,-6.1],[-2,0,2]],{name:'z min',snapWidth:0.25,precision:2});
var z1 = board.create('slider',[[1,-6.1],[6.8,-6.1],[-1,1,3]],{name:'z max',snapWidth:0.25,precision:2});
var target = {r0:1,r1:2.5,a0:0.25,a1:0.9,z0:-0.5,z1:1.5};
function current(){return {r0:r0.Value(),r1:r1.Value(),a0:a0.Value(),a1:a1.Value(),z0:z0.Value(),z1:z1.Value()};}

function addVolume(getBounds,color,width){
  function point(kind,t,b){
    var angle=Math.PI*(b.a0+t*(b.a1-b.a0));
    var radius=kind.outer ? b.r1 : b.r0;
    return [radius*Math.cos(angle),radius*Math.sin(angle),kind.top ? b.z1 : b.z0];
  }
  [{outer:false,top:false},{outer:true,top:false},{outer:false,top:true},{outer:true,top:true}].forEach(function(kind){
    view.create('curve3d',[
      function(t){return point(kind,t,getBounds())[0];},
      function(t){return point(kind,t,getBounds())[1];},
      function(t){return point(kind,t,getBounds())[2];},[0,1]
    ],{strokeColor:color,strokeWidth:width,fixed:true,highlight:false});
  });
  [0,1].forEach(function(side){
    [0,1].forEach(function(outer){
      view.create('curve3d',[
        function(){var b=getBounds(),a=Math.PI*(side?b.a1:b.a0),r=outer?b.r1:b.r0;return r*Math.cos(a);},
        function(){var b=getBounds(),a=Math.PI*(side?b.a1:b.a0),r=outer?b.r1:b.r0;return r*Math.sin(a);},
        function(t){var b=getBounds();return b.z0+t*(b.z1-b.z0);},[0,1]
      ],{strokeColor:color,strokeWidth:width,fixed:true,highlight:false});
    });
    [0,1].forEach(function(top){
      view.create('curve3d',[
        function(t){var b=getBounds(),a=Math.PI*(side?b.a1:b.a0),r=b.r0+t*(b.r1-b.r0);return r*Math.cos(a);},
        function(t){var b=getBounds(),a=Math.PI*(side?b.a1:b.a0),r=b.r0+t*(b.r1-b.r0);return r*Math.sin(a);},
        function(){var b=getBounds();return top?b.z1:b.z0;},[0,1]
      ],{strokeColor:color,strokeWidth:width,fixed:true,highlight:false});
    });
  });
}
addVolume(function(){return target;},'#15803d',6);
addVolume(current,'#f97316',3);
board.create('text',[-7.1,8.2,'<b style="color:#15803d">Green:</b> target &nbsp; <b style="color:#c2410c">Orange:</b> your region'],{fixed:true,fontSize:16});

JXG.QuartoAssessment.register({
  board:board,
  response:function(){var b=current();return {representation:'cylindrical-sector-bounds',
    radius:[b.r0,b.r1],anglePi:[b.a0,b.a1],height:[b.z0,b.z1]};},
  ai:{render:true,summary:function(data){return {representation:data.representation,
    radius:data.radius,anglePi:data.anglePi,height:data.height,
    feedbackPolicy:'Discuss radius, angle, and height intervals separately without revealing target values.'};}}
});
```
